text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I follow Mejiro Dober's gaze and<n>see a claw
machine filled with<n>Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-they just happened to catch my<n>eye. They're
pretty well designed<n>and whatnot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They're designed really well. You can<n>tell everyone
apart from their features<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could win a bunch of<n>them... Maybe I'll
give it a—
